    Quotients by subobjects #

    Generalities on cokernels of subobject inclusions in an abelian category:

    • an epimorphism π : X ⟶ Q identifies Q with the quotient of X by the kernel subobject of π (cokernelKernelSubobjectArrowIso);
    • images transport along isomorphisms of the target (imageSubobject_comp_iso_hom);
    • a zero object has only one subobject (Subobject.eq_of_isZero).

      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.imageSubobject_comp_iso_hom {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {X Y Y' : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (e : Y ≅ Y') :
      CategoryTheory.Limits.imageSubobject (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f e.hom) = CategoryTheory.Subobject.mk (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.Limits.imageSubobject f).arrow e.hom)

      The image of f ≫ e for an isomorphism e is the transport of the image of f.
